nitroxanalyser.changelog: Adds offline date/time entry and one-click phone/computer clock sync in Settings. Hold the button for two seconds to cancel printing back to the home screen. Removes clock-related delays, speeds up printer preparation and fixes USB detection and B1 battery reporting. Keeps the watchdog serviced during local firmware upload progress.

divesoftadapter.changelog: Adds offline date/time entry and one-click phone/computer clock sync in Settings, with optional battery-backed RTC storage. Manual time is used for labels and replaced automatically by internet time when available. Improves printer preparation and B1 battery reporting.
